blueprint_concepts: Angle bisector, centroid and incentre in vector form
Position vector, distance formula, section formula
english: Let $P(1,-2,3)$, $Q(-5,-5,9)$ and $R(5,0,7)$ be the vertices of a triangle $PQR$. The internal bisector of $\angle QPR$ meets the side $QR$ at the point $D$. Then the length of the segment $PD$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $P(1,-2,3)$, $Q(-5,-5,9)$ तथा $R(5,0,7)$ त्रिभुज $PQR$ के शीर्ष हैं। कोण $\angle QPR$ का आन्तरिक समद्विभाजक भुजा $QR$ से बिन्दु $D$ पर मिलता है। तब रेखाखण्ड $PD$ की लम्बाई ______ है।
solution_full: The internal bisector of $\angle QPR$ divides $QR$ internally in the ratio of the adjacent sides: $QD:DR=PQ:PR=9:6=3:2$.
(In vector form, $\overrightarrow{PD}$ is along $\dfrac{\overrightarrow{PQ}}{9}+\dfrac{\overrightarrow{PR}}{6}$, which gives the same point.)

Check: $\cos\angle QPD=\dfrac{\overrightarrow{PQ}\cdot\overrightarrow{PD}}{9\cdot 4.8}=\dfrac{6\cdot 4.8}{43.2}=\dfrac23$ and $\cos\angle RPD=\dfrac{4\cdot 4.8}{6\cdot 4.8}=\dfrac23$, equal as required.
originality_note: New: a space triangle with integer sides 9 and 6 at P whose bisector foot happens to lie directly 'above' P, so the bisector length is read off one coordinate after the section formula (way 5). Closest known: length of an angle bisector of a triangle by the formula 2bc cos(A/2)/(b+c). Different because: the triangle is in space with no right angle, and the length comes from the section formula, not from the angle.

concept_use.Angle bisector, centroid and incentre in: Internal bisector of angle P divides QR in the ratio PQ : PR = 3 : 2 (vector form of the bisector direction PQ/9 + PR/6).
concept_use.Position vector, distance formula, secti: Distance formula for PQ, PR and PD, and the section formula D = (2Q + 3R)/5.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol and object is introduced before use, every condition is stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently with sympy/mpmath, is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked the two angles at P are equal (cosines 2/3). Changed: No change.
key_step: Ratio QD:DR = 3:2 from the bisector, then the section formula.
justification: Routine chain of distance formula, bisector ratio, section formula and one more distance; no insight. Like 2026-P2-Q1 (L2) and the section-formula checks of 2023-P2-Q4 (L1), one stage longer.
